Hi everyone,
I recently received an offer for an engineering position in Massachusetts paying $95k, with an $8k sign-on bonus to help with relocation.
I’m 25 and currently live in SoCal, making around $86-87k in an engineering role I’ve been trying to leave for the past year. My girlfriend, family, and a few friends are all here.

I’m really torn between staying and continuing to search for something local or somewhere with better pay relative to the cost of living and accepting this offer and starting over in MA. I’ve been looking at rent there, and it’s expensive. I’m worried that a large portion of my paycheck would go toward rent.
I’d appreciate any advice or stories from anyone who’s been in a similar situation!
